The '''HM-5 homing missile''' was a type of [[Missile/Legends|missile]] manufactured by [[Dymek/Legends|Dymek]]. It consisted of a warhead, guidance fins, a [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] charge, a sensor flange, and a pressure engine. Under [[Jango Fett]]'s ownership, the [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] was equipped with such missiles, among other weapons.<ref name="AOTC Guide" />
